figurative_meaning_en: courtesy, respect, entertainment or flattery towards superiors
example_sentences_in_bangla: উপরওয়ালাকে তোয়াজ করে কাজ সহজ করা যায়।
example_sentences_in_english: Flattering the boss can make work easier.
note: Derived from Persian/Arabic 'tawajjuh' meaning attention or regard, adapted in Bengali for social deference.
